M1.question_boundary: data invariance and adversarial synthesis diagnostics
M1.architectural_thesis: lock dataset invariance, paraphrase robustness, and foil acceptance before architectural coupling work.

M2.architectural_thesis: replace static objective blending with lexicographic augmented-Lagrangian control while preserving scoped identity and arity constraints.

M3.architectural_thesis: test how structured advisor state should couple back into generation without collapsing the decoder's English continuation manifold.
forbidden_drift_axes: discriminator-only evaluation as sole success criterion

M4.question_boundary: semantic grounding and predicate family structure
M4.architectural_thesis: improve predicate and operator grounding before later chain-style reasoning expansions.

M5.architectural_thesis: test autoregressive, masked-pair, and padded-n-ary chain formats for structured reasoning serialization.

M6.architectural_thesis: test a direct logic-engine bridge and its calibration limits before interleaved and council-style decompositions.

M7.architectural_thesis: interleave structured coprocessor steps with base decoding while preserving operator semantics.

M8.architectural_thesis: test multi-oracle composition against a monolithic English baseline and direct council rollout.

M9.question_boundary: provenance manifold and contrastive NLI engine
M9.architectural_thesis: replace monolithic vocabulary state with a provenance-aware manifold and synchronized tokenizer-backed reasoning engine.
forbidden_drift_axes: M10 translator/head swap during base forge phases

M10.architectural_thesis: translate structured manifold state into English-compatible continuation or discriminative readout heads.
forbidden_drift_axes: re-entry scratchpad mediation without explicit family reboot

M11.architectural_thesis: prove that the manifold carries useful cognition through native discriminative heads even when generative re-entry remains unresolved.
forbidden_drift_axes: raw generative rollout claims without re-entry metrics

M14.architectural_thesis: use bounded scratchpad tokens as a compute horizon while injecting continuous advisor math only into scratchpad states before English resumption.
forbidden_drift_axes: direct raw sidecar exposure to answer token

M18.architectural_thesis: extract salient hidden-state structure, induce a compact relation graph, and steer a second decoder pass with compiled attention bias instead of raw foreign-state injection.
forbidden_drift_axes: raw scratchpad runway injection as the main intervention surface
headline accuracy claims without kill or random controls

M19.architectural_thesis: compress tapped hidden state into a learned continuous runway over repeated <symbiote> token positions so the decoder gets multiple normal attention hops before final-answer English resumption.
forbidden_drift_axes: generic checkpoint renaming after train time
console-only reporting without per-cell json artifacts

M20.architectural_thesis: pretrain a factorized predicate dictionary before bridge work so code tokens carry causal properties, stay invariant under entity swaps, and remain silent without grounded brivi arguments.
forbidden_drift_axes: M19 runway patching as the main intervention
entity-name dictionary memorization as a success criterion

M21.architectural_thesis: replace fixed typed slots with variable-length bridi traces so the model learns how many gismu predicates, cmavo modifiers, and judri bindings are needed, then proves those frames are causally useful.
forbidden_drift_axes: fixed typed-slot layout as main result
mass deletion of M20 control assets

M22.question_boundary: semantic coverage generalization over the M21 dynamic bridi substrate
M22.architectural_thesis: keep the M21 dynamic bridi Q-former fixed and test whether expanded semantic surfaces generalize beyond memorized synthetic templates without damaging clean accuracy or judri causality.
forbidden_drift_axes: new geometry as the main intervention
sacrificing judri causal delta for surface accuracy

M23.question_boundary: causal frame relevance over the M21/M22 dynamic bridi substrate
M23.architectural_thesis: hold the Lojbanic dictionary and dynamic bridi trace fixed, then test whether answer-causal frame selection requires an explicit relevance router under decoy relation OOD.
forbidden_drift_axes: new broad gauntlet surfaces unrelated to relevance
promotion from clean accuracy without decoy OOD lift
